children: Coal India shares gained up to 3 per cent in Tuesday's trading session after global brokerage Morgan Stanley upgraded the stock to "overweight" from "equal-weight" on an improving earnings outlook.
Morgan Stanley has set a target price of Rs 480 per share, implying an upside potential of 16 per cent from the previous closing level.
The brokerage said accelerating thermal power demand, sharply reduced plant inventories and rising global thermal coal prices are expected to support volumes and e-auction premiums.
These factors are expected to drive earnings upgrades and support the stock's performance over the next few months, it said.
Morgan Stanley revised its volume and e-auction premium estimates, resulting in a 20 per cent upgrade to its FY27 earnings per share estimate.

At 6.6 times one-year forward price-to-earnings, the stock is trading around its long-term averages, the brokerage said, adding that it expects the valuation multiple to sustain on the back of strong earnings upgrades.

title: Coal India shares gain 3% on Morgan Stanley upgrade, global brokerage sees 16% upside
